mapper.sql: select p.policy_id, p.policy_name, p.material_id, p.material_type, p.warn_days, p.freeze_days, p.min_ship_days, p.fefo_enabled, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, mm.material_name from food_expiry_policy p left join wms_material mm on mm.material_id = p.material_id
mapper.select: where p.material_id = #{materialId} and p.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.policy_id limit 1
where p.material_id = 0 and p.material_type = #{materialType} and p.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.policy_id limit 1
where p.material_id = 0 and p.material_type = '' and p.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.policy_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into food_expiry_policy (policy_name, material_id, material_type, warn_days, freeze_days, min_ship_days, fefo_enabled, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{policyName}, #{materialId}, #{materialType}, #{warnDays}, #{freezeDays}, #{minShipDays}, #{fefoEnabled}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
